# Timeline Requirements Checklist: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage) of
`spec.md`'s requirements for "Meus Registros", with emphasis on this unit's four highest-risk requirement
clusters: synchronization-badge/session independence, pagination and local/backend merge-by-ID dedup, the
empty-state re-entry flow, and session-expiry overlay recovery — plus a dedicated edge-case sweep.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for how the screen behaves when both the local in-memory store and the first backend page are still loading simultaneously, including which renders first? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the fetch/page-size scope of pagination, or is batch size left entirely to implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement defining what "scroll position preservation" means structurally (e.g., same top-visible entry vs. same pixel offset) when entries are appended below the current view? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a retry is presented and triggered when a page load fails, beyond "a clear, retryable message"? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the sync badge's three-state computation rules defined at the specification level (beyond "following sync-badge semantics"), so FR-005's acceptance criteria don't depend solely on an externally referenced document? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "restored exactly as it was" (US3 AC2, FR-007) defined with objective, checkable criteria (identical entry set, order, and scroll position) rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "without disturbing already-rendered cards" (FR-003) given a concrete, testable definition distinguishing it from a cosmetically similar but technically different re-render? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "text excerpt" (FR-002) quantified with a maximum length or truncation rule? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a clear, retryable message" (FR-009, Edge Cases) specified with concrete content/behavior requirements rather than only described qualitatively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the Clarifications section and SC-001 agree on which copy of a duplicate (local vs. freshly fetched) entry takes precedence after a merge? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Do FR-005 ("independent of... session handling") and FR-007 ("reconciling... by re-confirming that specific entry") agree on when `GET /entries/:id` is invoked relative to session renewal? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the reverse-chronological ordering rule (Clarifications, FR-002) and the Edge Case stating "paging continues to load older groups" when a recent page is empty mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-001's "100% of entries appear exactly once" be objectively measured given the spec's description of the local/backend merge, including the chat-origin edge case? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-004's "entries and scroll position are unchanged" be verified without first resolving CHK006's definition of "unchanged"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-005's "unaffected by whatever is happening with the user's session" stated in a falsifiable way (a concrete before/after comparison), or only qualitatively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Sync Badge & Session Independence (focus area)

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for the badge shown on an entry that was only ever fetched from the backend (never locally tracked for a pending write)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for badge behavior during any window between session-expiration detection and the overlay's actual appearance? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the spec define what the badge/reconciliation does if the `GET /entries/:id` re-confirmation call (per the Clarifications) itself fails or times out? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for how "synchronizing" and "synchronization error" states are ever triggered at all, given the Assumptions note that today's own capture flow may never produce them? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]

## Pagination & Merge/Dedup (focus area)

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the same entry ID appearing across two different fetched backend pages (cursor drift), separately from the local/backend dedup case already covered? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the interaction between "new empty-state entry appears immediately" (FR-004) and "further pages load while scrolling" (FR-003) specified for where that new entry's date group sits relative to already-loaded pages? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the trigger for loading further pages (e.g., a scroll-distance threshold) specified at the requirements level, or left entirely to implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Is there a requirement preventing redundant or duplicated page fetches from rapid or repeated load-more triggers? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Empty State & Entry-Creation Re-entry (focus area)

- [ ] CHK024 Is the transition from empty state to populated list specified (e.g., any required behavior, or explicitly left unspecified) rather than silently assumed? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it specified whether the newly created entry is shown optimistically or only after backend confirmation, during the empty-state-to-populated transition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the user cancelling or backing out of the entry-creation flow launched from the empty state without saving? [Gap, Spec §US2]

## Session-Expiry Overlay Recovery (focus area)

- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for what interaction (if any) remains available on the timeline underneath the "Sessão expirada" overlay while it is visible? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §US3]
- [ ] CHK028 Is there a requirement covering repeated/consecutive session expirations while the screen remains open (expire → renew → expire again)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the spec define any timing expectation for restoration after re-authentication, or is "exactly as it was" purely structural with no timing bound? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Is the boundary between "offline" (FR-009) and "page load fails outright" (Edge Cases) specified clearly enough to determine which message the system shows in each case? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the chat-origin entry's visual treatment (marker/icon) traceable to a specific defined source, rather than only asserted to exist? [Traceability, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Does FR-002's "tags appear only when present" explicitly cover an entry whose tags list is present but empty, distinct from "no tags attached"? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK033 Is reaching "the end of history" (Edge Cases) given any positive, observable requirement (e.g., no further fetch attempts, no spinner), or only the negative statement "no error"? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the Assumptions-section claim that RF01's local store only ever contains backend-confirmed entries (used to justify ID-based dedup) traceable to RF01's own documented save-flow guarantee, rather than merely re-asserted here? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the dependency on `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md` for badge-state correctness referenced consistently everywhere FR-005 and SC-005 are stated, not only once in Assumptions? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005, §SC-005, Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 Does FR-008 leave any ambiguity about what a tap on the inert download/search affordances should visibly do (no-op vs. disabled styling), given it must match the prototype but perform no behavior? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
